<div id="map-aug08" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-aug08').setView([37.5200, 127.0550], 12);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 Hotel — Voco Myeongdong or Gangnam (TBD)', lat:37.5572, lng:126.9680, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Voco+Myeongdong+Seoul' },
    { name:'EcoJardin Head Spa 💆 (Aeogae)', lat:37.5572, lng:126.9476, c:'#26A69A', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=EcoJardin+head+spa+Aeogae+Seoul' },
    { name:'Han River Biking 🚲', lat:37.5263, lng:126.9348, c:'#1565C0', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Han+River+bike+rental+Seoul' },
    { name:'COEX & Starfield Library 📚', lat:37.5126, lng:127.0594, c:'#1565C0', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=COEX+Starfield+Library+Seoul' },
    { name:'HYBE Headquarters 🎵', lat:37.5073, lng:127.0391, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=HYBE+Headquarters+Seoul' },
    { name:'SM Entertainment 🎤', lat:37.5178, lng:127.0429, c:'#E53935', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=SM+Entertainment+Seoul' },
    { name:'JYP Entertainment 🎵', lat:37.5193, lng:127.0282, c:'#FFA726', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=JYP+Entertainment+Seoul' },
    { name:'YG Entertainment 🎵', lat:37.5795, lng:126.9460, c:'#212121', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=YG+Entertainment+Seoul' },
    { name:'논현삼계탕 🍗 (Lunch)', lat:37.5161, lng:127.0299, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=논현삼계탕+Nonhyeon+Seoul' },
    { name:'KimbuksoonKeunNambijip 🍲 (Lunch Alt)', lat:37.5200, lng:127.0300, c:'#66BB6A', url:'https://share.google/bsbvExAPWRr1jouiu' },
    { name:'SeoulMong 🍱 (Final Dinner)', lat:37.5600, lng:126.9850, c:'#C62828', url:'https://share.google/SnMuyIDAcAsxLyQCl' },
    { name:'Lotte World Tower 🌃', lat:37.5126, lng:127.1021, c:'#8B0000', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Lotte+World+Tower+Seoul+Sky' },
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>

```{=html}
<div class="section-header">Morning — Han River Biking</div>

<div class="event-card morning" data-dt="2026-08-08T11:00" data-lat="37.5263" data-lng="126.9348">
  <div class="event-time">11:00</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">🚲 Biking</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Han River Biking</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Rent bikes and cruise the Han River bike path — one of Seoul's most classic activities. Flat, scenic paths along both banks with city skyline views. Rental stations available along the riverside parks.
      <ul>
        <li>Yeouido Hangang Park has the most convenient rental stations</li>
        <li>Bike rentals are very affordable — ₩3,000–5,000/hour</li>
        <li>Path connects to Banpo, Mapodaegyo, and beyond</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Han+River+bike+rental+Yeouido+Seoul" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Han River Bikes</a>
      <a href="https://map.naver.com/p/search/한강+자전거+대여" target="_blank" class="maps-link naver-link">🗺 Naver</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

    <div class="event-notes">Korea's tallest building (555m) with Seoul Sky Observatory on floors 117–123. Breathtaking night views over Seoul's glittering skyline — a perfect finale to the trip. Includes glass-floored sky bridge.

        <li>Best visited after dark for city lights</li>
        <li>Entry ~₩29,000</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
